findings.topic: Greek image is actually Greek + Butler
findings.detail: greek-split shows the Ἑλληνικά mode selected, 'Butler (1900) · EN', Book I 'Athena Visits Ithaca', Butler's English prose on the left, and the Ancient Greek Od. 1.1–24 (ἄνδρα μοι ἔννεπε, μοῦσα, πολύτροπον … ἔσχατοι ἀνδρῶν) with line numbers on the right. The alt 'Skald 0.7.0 on iPad, with the Ancient Greek beside an English translation.' is accurate.

The iPhone capture shows Butler (1900) · EN, Book I, 'Tell me, O Muse…', a margin reading note (ζή(τει) RARE WORD) and the Lastman art plate. 'showing Butler's opening of Book I with reading notes and historical art' is accurate. The ' entity matches the reviewed candidate-native-index.html byte-for-byte.

The capture shows 'Odysseus and Minerva', 'PIETER LASTMAN, 1625', 'SEE IT IN REAL LIFE → REMBRANDTHUIS · AMSTERDAM, NETHERLANDS', and a passage note. App data agrees. panels.json artifact rembrandthuis-lastman-odysseus-minerva has credit 'Cultural Heritage Agency of the Netherlands, NK collection (NK 1830), on long-term loan to Museum Het Rembrandthuis', certainty_tier confirmed, museum_url wo2.collectienederland.nl/doc/nk/NK1830. Book I master.json has museum_label 'Rembrandthuis · Amsterdam, Netherlands'. The image meta names the Commons file for NK1830, PD-Art. The alt '…Pieter Lastman’s Odysseus and Minerva with its collection details and a reading note.' and caption 'Open an artwork alongside the poem.' are accurate and name no museum or on-view status. Limitation: my live public-source fetch (RCE/Commons) was not permitted in this session, so this check rests on repository records and the visible capture.

findings.topic: Voyage map: Book I, map uncovered

The unchanged figcaption 'Trace the long route toward home without leaving the reader.' is consistent: the map is a sheet over the reader.

The approved words are exact. The old skald-odyssey-og.jpg is retained for other routes.

The notice 'A look at our next app update. The expanded library described here is coming in version 0.7.0; the stores currently offer an earlier version.' remains unchanged. The existing availability lines (US, Canada, Australia, NZ FAQ; 'Available now on Android, iPhone, and iPad') are unchanged. The diff adds no EU/UK or other availability claims.

The unchanged Greek figcaption 'Read the Greek beside a translation, with linked scrolling.' was previously reviewed body copy and is not altered here. A still image cannot show scrolling, but the capture does not contradict it. No change required.
